notes:
OCRelay 1.1.25

REVIEW PANELS, EVERY STUDY

• The review panel no longer grows past the bottom of the screen. When its rows don't fit, they scroll, and Confirm stays in view.
• The review panel opens where you last left it.
• Long values wrap onto more lines instead of being cut off. Hover over a short number box to see a value too long for it.
• If a red alert is scrolled out of view, a red line above Confirm says so — click it to scroll there.
• Fields you change from what the AI read get a violet outline, with a count above Confirm.
